Author: BlueWaveXIV
Name: AutoBuy
Description: Private Market Board helper that searches configured gear keywords and buys listings at or below a configurable gil cap.
Punchline: Buy underpriced gear sets from the Market Board.
Changelog: Universalis item-list rows now turn green when the current character has at least 500 of that item in normal inventory bags. Added a small inventory count indicator beside each item row.
